landing.faq.title: FAQ
landing.faq.a1: A platform for CTF competitions and hands-on security practice: flag-checked challenges, isolated labs and a live scoreboard in one place. Built at KhNURE by the V. V. Popovskyi ICE Department.
landing.faq.a2: Players — university and school students and teams from other institutions — and organizers who run competitions and olympiads.
landing.faq.q3: Can I play solo, or only in a team?
landing.faq.a3: Both. The organizer picks an individual or a team format; in a team event you create a team or join one with a code.
landing.faq.q4: What kinds of challenges are there?
landing.faq.a4: Web, crypto, binary exploitation, reverse engineering, forensics. Simple challenges are checked by flag; advanced ones deploy their own infrastructure.

landing.faq.a7: Flags are checked on the server and labs are isolated from each other. The organizer sees every attempt and can annul a solve.
landing.faq.q8: How do I run my own event?
landing.faq.a8: Organizers set up the event themselves: format, registration, challenges from the catalog, pages and the live screen. Organizer access comes from the platform team.
landing.faq.q9: What does it cost and how do I start?
landing.faq.a9: Taking part is free. Start with the warm-up on this page, then register for an event via the organizer's link.

legal.terms.title: Terms of Use
legal.terms.intro: These Terms govern access to and use of the CyberICEBox platform — an environment for cybersecurity training labs and CTF competitions. By registering, you agree to these Terms.
legal.terms.s1.heading: Acceptance of terms
legal.terms.s1.body: By creating an account or taking part in events, you confirm that you have read and agree to follow these Terms and the Privacy Policy.
legal.terms.s2.heading: Acceptable use of labs
legal.terms.s2.body: All vulnerable targets and infrastructure are provided for training purposes only, inside isolated labs. Using the techniques or tools you learn against systems outside the provided environment without their owners' written permission is prohibited.
legal.terms.s3.heading: Fair play in competitions
legal.terms.s3.body: Prohibited: sharing flags or solutions during an active event, attacking the platform's infrastructure or other participants, using several accounts to inflate points. Violations lead to disqualification.
legal.terms.s4.heading: Accounts and teams
legal.terms.s4.body: You are responsible for keeping access to your account secure. Teams are formed by participants; organizers may limit team size for specific events.
legal.terms.s5.heading: Intellectual property
legal.terms.s5.body: Challenges, lab scenarios and platform materials belong to CyberICEBox and its partners. Distributing challenge statements outside the platform without permission is prohibited.
legal.terms.s6.heading: Changes and termination
legal.terms.s6.body: We may update these Terms and suspend access if they are violated. Significant changes will be announced on the platform or by email.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro: This Policy explains what data the CyberICEBox platform processes, for what purpose and how we protect it. We process only the minimum data needed to run training labs and competitions.
legal.privacy.s1.heading: Data we process
legal.privacy.s1.body: Account: name, email address and, optionally, a Google identifier. Activity: event participation, submitted solutions, points and team membership. Technical data: access logs for labs and VPN sessions, kept for security.
legal.privacy.s2.heading: Purpose of processing
legal.privacy.s2.body: Data is used for authentication, access to isolated environments, rankings and abuse prevention. We do not sell personal data to third parties.
legal.privacy.s3.heading: Sign-in with Google
legal.privacy.s3.body: If you sign in with Google, we receive only the basic profile (name and email) to create your account. The platform has no access to your Google password.
legal.privacy.s4.heading: Sessions and cookies
legal.privacy.s4.body: We use strictly necessary cookies to keep you signed in. No third-party analytics or advertising trackers are used.
legal.privacy.s5.heading: Retention and deletion
legal.privacy.s5.body: Account data is kept while the account is active. You can request account deletion — personal data is then deleted, except for anonymized records needed to keep competition results intact.
legal.privacy.s6.heading: Security
legal.privacy.s6.body: Lab access is isolated at the network level; training targets contain no real personal data. Data in transit is encrypted (TLS, WireGuard).
legal.privacy.s7.heading: Your rights
legal.privacy.s7.body: You have the right to access, correct and delete your data, and to receive a copy of it. To exercise these rights, use the contacts below.
